dimensions.V: practical value from affected accepted entries/surfaces, discounted for lexical-screen failures
dimensions.F: false-positive control strength (higher means risk can be constrained)
dimensions.R: rejection-reason reopenability (higher means the family reason can be addressed without overturning other rejection gates)

formula.limitations: Scores are prioritization rubrics, not probabilities or SAFE decisions. Rubric ratings are explicit judgment; population counts and reason distributions are mechanical.

ranked_families.false_positive_risk: HIGH: and/an changes grammatical function; actual ASR confusion is unmeasured.
ranked_families.rationale: Only reviewed row cluster with a dictionary-listed weak form matching exact one-phone loss, exact lexical target and bounded consonant context; high false-positive risk remains.
